# A Trini Traveller

> > Personal travel blog chronicling the experiences of Jenson, a Trinidadian expat living and teaching in Toyama, Japan, with stories spanning cultural immersion, teaching moments, and journeys across Asia.

The blog focuses on authentic, personal narratives from life in Japan, particularly through the JET Programme teaching experience in Toyama and Namerikawa. Stories blend cultural observations, travel adventures to destinations like Kyoto, Bangkok, and Cambodia, with reflections on expat life and cross-cultural connections.

## Key Topics

- Japan expat life
- Toyama and Namerikawa
- JET Programme teaching
- Kyoto travel
- Cultural immersion
- Kabuki theater
- Traditional Japanese performance
- Southeast Asia travel
- Trinidad perspective
- Personal reflection
- Cross-cultural experiences
- Japanese education
- Budget travel
- Golden Week adventures
